title: Glossary
confirmPushReplaceDescription: This first deletes every DeepL glossary this app manages — across every project on this server, not just this one — then pushes this glossary fresh. Terms and language pairs you removed locally disappear from DeepL too, and every other project's pushed terms are erased until that project is pushed again.
emptyTermsTitle: No terms in this glossary yet
emptyTermsHint: Add a term below, import a CSV, or generate terms with AI.
emptyTermsReadOnly: This glossary is managed globally and has no terms to show.
sourceLink: GI: MW Glossary / Common Translation Sheet
noGlossarySelected: Select a glossary to view its terms.
confirmDeleteDescription: Remove this term from the glossary?
confirmDeleteGlossaryDescription: Delete this glossary and all its terms? This cannot be undone.
confirmEnableApplyDescription: Auto-apply glossary matches to your entries now?
toastGeneratedPartial: Created {{created}} of {{total}} glossaries ({{failed}} failed), assigned to {{entries}} entries
toastGenerateVaultLocked: Vault locked — created {{created}} of {{total}} glossaries; unlock and retry the rest
generateDescription: Let an AI model scan the source text and suggest glossaries of recurring custom terms and names.
generateNoModules: No AI-capable module is available. Enable an AI module in the project's configuration first.
generateNoSuggestions: The AI found no new terms to suggest.
generateRunningHint: This runs in the background — you can close this dialog or switch tabs. Track it in the Activity tab; reopen Generate to review the suggestions when it finishes.
generateBatchCount_other: Will run in ~{{count}} batches (one request each, ~{{count}} progress steps).
generateIncludeTranslationsHint: Also copy each term's translation from the selected languages' existing translations. Requires at least one language checked above; terms without evidence stay untranslated.
generateFocusSourceTextsHint: Optional: paste exact source text (one per line) to restrict this run to only those entries, combined with any other scope above.
generateFocusSourceTextsPlaceholder: One exact source text per line…
translateTermsDescription: Translate this glossary's terms that are missing a translation into your active languages.
toastBackupError: Failed to back up before accepting; nothing was changed
disabledBanner: This glossary is disabled and will not be used during import or translation.
importPreviewDescription: Review the changes before applying them to "{{name}}".
importConflictHint: Conflicting terms will overwrite the existing translation for the listed languages.
importNoChanges: This file makes no changes to the glossary.
toastRepushRequired: Glossary changed since the last DeepL push — push it again to update DeepL
flaggedHint: These terms are missing a translation for one or more of your active languages, so they're excluded from matching, assignment, and translation reference until every language is filled in.
